name: Snuff Flag -Arui wa Suiren e Hikari ga Sasu You ni-
original_name: SNuff FLag - あるいは睡蓮へ光が射すように -
source:
"SNuff FLag - As Light Sheds On Water Lily -" is a Horror Adventure Visual Novel where a high school student "Takayoshi Katou" is invited to the occult research club and drifts with the club members into the five mysterious stories.

You will face a variety of endings, including happy and melancholic ones depending on how you progress through the stories.

113 endings in total. When the true end, only one in 113, appears right before your eyes, whether you accept it as true or not...

...is completely up to you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ171393.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《SNuff FLag——如光照在睡莲上——》是一部恐怖冒险视觉小说。高中生加藤隆义受邀加入超自然研究社，和社团成员一起卷入五个神秘故事。

随着故事推进，你将面对各种结局，其中既有幸福，也有忧郁。

总计113个结局。当唯一的真结局出现在你眼前时——无论你是否接受它为真实……

一切都由你决定。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ171393.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
